all span ordering, bounds, output sizes and tile IDs

implementation.unimplemented: One ordered encoded-byte read plan shared by FNV and payload validators; this slice does not combine those reads.

benchmark.method: One identical driver object linked against each frozen core library. Same receipt-bound split files; source hashes are read before timing. Each open runs in a fresh process, with one excluded warmup per binary and locale, then alternating binary and locale order across measured rounds. Elapsed time is host steady-clock wall time without startup drawing, App initialization or first render. Counts describe requested FILE callbacks/bytes/seeks, not physical disk transfers or CPU work.
benchmark.quiet_window: Other team builds, browser execution and Firebird work paused during accepted measured opens.
benchmark.scope: SplitResourceSource::open and Content::open; excludes fopen/length discovery, Content allocation, progress drawing, App::init, preference writes and first render.
benchmark.host_caches: Input hashing before timing warms OS pages; no cache flush. Fresh process is not cold storage.
benchmark.interpretation: Per-language tile-index requests fall by 227 (16.4254703%) and requested bytes by 467232 (4.4599352%). FNV and retained-image phase request counters are unchanged. Open median reductions 3.9511784% ZHS / 3.4008912% ENG are modest host observations with overlapping ranges and variation in unchanged phases; not a physical-device or Firebird improvement estimate.

content_fixture.cause: Fixture produced 160 image descriptors to exceed a historical 90-entry cache, but production capacity is 320; requested image remained cached so injected file failure was correctly unobserved.
content_fixture.fix: Use Content::image_capacity_entries()+32 distinct images (352) and assert image0 evicted/image1 cached before the unchanged fault, other-owner-health and reopen assertions.
